plainText:
Brittany Cox (born 18 July 1988) is a voice actress for the English-language dub of . She is currently affiliated with A3 Artists Agency in Los Angeles and Big Fish NW Talent in Seattle.

==Biography==
Cox is an American voice actress, born in Raleigh, North Carolina. In the Pokémon franchise, Cox first voiced in Pokémon Masters EX. She then joined the during , where she voiced Sonia.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Sonia

===Video games===
====Pokémon Masters EX====

Jupiter
